material_findings: Monitoring v5 is a material source improvement over v4: the legacy v3 metrics builder is confined to an isolated staging repo and no longer writes legacy authority/runtime truth to canonical paths before hardening.

The v5 receipt itself states repository-bound tests have not executed and runtime credit remains zero. Retained publication is not yet switched: fresh autonomous metrics commits after the v5 source commit still publish free swarm/SYSTEM_ANALYSIS_LIVE.json with schema CLAY_FREE_SWARM_SYSTEM_ANALYSIS/v3.

A remaining publication-set coherence gap exists in v5: SYSTEM_ANALYSIS_PROVENANCE_V5.json, SYSTEM_ANALYSIS_LIVE.json, and README.md are each replaced atomically but are published sequentially. Per-file os.replace/rename atomicity does not make the three-file publication a single atomic transaction. A concurrent multi-file reader can therefore observe mixed generations unless readers bind a common publication generation/digest and fail closed on mismatch.

This is a monitoring/control-observability soundness issue only. It is not evidence of provider execution, runtime quiescence, HCU success, training success, BASE package completion, or canonical semantics.
